claim_scope: Reporting exists about April 16 2024 Borden injury, lawsuit and disputed account; allegations are not established facts.
duplicate_handling: CBC regular/lite/video, Yahoo syndication, WestNet attribution, Canada-today aggregation and Defense Post follow-on are not independent corroborations.
ordinary_explanation: Article itself reports weapons technicians best estimate of user error, disputed by claimant and lawyer; DND declined comment due to litigation.
decision: Covered control succeeds; do not call C22 incident uncovered. Packet comparison would be needed to establish any additional incident or warning.
limitation: One purposively chosen known-covered event is not a recall estimate; text limited to requested maximum.
